finding: CLASS-L-BIPARTITE-LAPLACIAN-ATTESTED-ANATOMICALLY. Bucket 1 — BBB anatomical structure is explicitly bipartite: Node-set A = vascular endothelial cells + tight-junction proteins + P-gp efflux + receptor-mediated transcytosis; Node-set B = astrocyte perivascular endfeet + neural ECF + pericytes + basement membrane. Edges only between sets via tight-junction proteins + transporters + channels. Daneman & Prat 2015 PMC4292164 PDF-extracted: 'endothelial cells (ECs) are held together by tight junctions (TJs), which greatly limit the paracellular flux of solutes. Astrocytes extend processes that almost completely ensheath the vascular tube with specialized endfeet containing aquaporin 4 and dystrophin complexes anchoring to the basement membrane.' Abbott 2002 PMC1570746 PDF-extracted: 'endfeet of astrocytic glia form a lacework of fine lamellae closely apposed to the outer surface of the endothelium... endothelium and astrocytes are involved in two-way induction.' By Chung 1997 cite-by-ref spectral graph theory, bipartite graphs have normalised Laplacian eigenvalue ≤ 2 and symmetric spectrum. Honest weakness: no PMC paper has computed the actual BBB bipartite Laplacian eigenspectrum — Spike #135.1 follow-up candidate.

finding: CLASS-M-SELECTIVE-PERMEABILITY-HDC-ATTESTED-VIA-INFERENCE. Bucket 2 — BBB exhibits size-selective permeability (uncharged molecules up to 4 nm; low permeability for larger) + lipophilicity gating + transporter-binding-affinity dependence (Daneman & Prat 2015 PMC4292164 PDF-extracted). Framework lens: each molecule's permeation IS an HDC similarity check between molecule-feature-hypervector and membrane-feature-hypervector. High similarity to admitted-class → traversal; low similarity → exclusion. The 4 nm size cutoff is one bit; lipophilicity is another; transporter-binding-affinity is another. Class M HDC bind/bundle/permute/similarity (XOR self-inverse algebra per Plate 1995 / Kanerva 2009 / Spike #114 Option B) attested via inference from documented selectivity rules. Honest weakness: no PMC paper explicitly applies HDC algebra to BBB selectivity — same level of attestation as mycorrhizal Class M (Spike #130 §2.2).

finding: CLASS-C-DUAL-DIRECTION-TRANSPORT-ATTESTED-EXPLICITLY. Bucket 3 — BBB exhibits two complementary cascade-orientations running in parallel: Influx cascade-orientation A→B (blood-to-brain; nutrients, lipid-soluble small molecules via GLUT1/LAT1/MCT1/TfR/InsR/etc.); Efflux cascade-orientation B→A (brain-to-blood; xenobiotics, drugs, amyloid-β via P-gp/BCRP/MRP2/etc.). Daneman & Prat 2015 PMC4292164 PDF-extracted: 'Efflux transporters like P-glycoprotein actively transport a wide variety of lipophilic molecules back toward blood... nutrient transporters facilitate entry; GLUT1 facilitates the transport of glucose down its concentration gradient from the blood into the brain.' FLZ-BBB study (PLOS One 2014 cite-by-ref): bidirectional transport assessed in apical-to-basolateral A→B and basolateral-to-apical B→A directions in in vitro BBB models. Same Class C cascade-orientation that orients gear-DAG rotation (Antikythera), action-flow in chess, advective mass-flow in mycorrhizal hyphae (Gorzelak 2015), STDP τ-asymmetric causal direction (Sgritta 2017). Cleanest Class C attestation in project canon.

finding: CLASS-K-MICHAELIS-MENTEN-SATURATION-ATTESTED-EXPLICITLY. Bucket 4 — GLUT1 at BBB exhibits explicit Michaelis-Menten saturable kinetics with Duarte 2009 PMC2795468 PDF-extracted parameters: K_t (apparent Michaelis constant) = 1.5-3.5 mM; T_max/CMR_glc ratio = 4.6-5.6; K_ii (iso-inhibition constant) = 51-149 mM. Four-state conformational model reduces to standard reversible Michaelis-Menten under physiological conditions: v_0/V_max = (G_out - G_in)/(K_M + G_in + G_out + (G_out·G_in)/K_ii). Authors verbatim: 'The process of glucose transport in the brain is saturable...but not rate limiting for the glycolytic pathway.' LAT1 similarly saturable (Daneman & Prat 2015 PMC4292164 cite for large neutral amino acid transport). P-glycoprotein saturates at high substrate concentration. Class K asymptotic-DOF primitive per [[user_stance_asymptotic_dof_sidesteps_infinity]]: every transporter at BBB asymptotes to V_max as substrate concentration → ∞. Strongest mathematical-formalism attestation across all 7 cascade-classes in this spike.

finding: CLASS-I-CIRCADIAN-PERMEABILITY-RHYTHM-ATTESTED-EXPLICITLY. Bucket 5 — BBB exhibits endogenous 24h circadian rhythm controlling transporter function. Cuddapah-Zhang-Sehgal 2019 PMC6602072 PDF-extracted: TNFα uptake peaks ZT20-23 (rest); leptin influx peaks ZT14-18 (active); β-amyloid levels peak ZT18-24; fly-BBB perineurial-glia maintain circadian Mg²⁺ oscillations — high daytime Mg²⁺ increases P-gp activity and decreases permeability, nighttime gap-junction (Inx1/Inx2) upregulation reduces Mg²⁺ in subperineurial glia, decreasing P-gp activity and increasing permeability. Kim-Keep-Zhang 2024 PMC11584049 PDF-extracted: 'efflux is higher when the animal is active and is reduced in the inactive phase.' Documented circadian transporters: P-gp/ABCB1, MRP2/ABCC2, BCRP/ABCG2, ~300 SLC solute carriers. Class I cyclic-substrate ℤ/n with n=24h corresponds to circadian period. Honest weakness: Kim 2024 explicitly notes no harmonic-function differential equations provided — standard sin/cos circadian-biology equations cite-by-ref only.

finding: MS-#14-CHANNEL-(f)-VASCULAR-NEURAL-INTERFACE-DRIFT-KEYSTONE-ESTABLISHED. Cascade-shape signal: delta(local_implant_baseline, current_state) over time. Channels (a)-(e) → online retraining sufficient. finding: PARTITION-COEXISTENT-WITH-MYCORRHIZAL-AT-CASCADE-BACKBONE. BBB and mycorrhizal interface share the same L+M+C+K+I backbone with substrate-specific operator substitutions: Class L = endothelial-astrocyte bipartite (BBB) vs plant-fungus bipartite scale-free + small-world (mycorrhizal Beiler 2010); Class M = selective permeability HDC similarity by molecule features (BBB) vs chemical-signal HDC of phytohormone alphabet jasmonate/salicylate/methyl-derivatives/amino-acids (mycorrhizal Gorzelak 2015); Class C = dual-direction transport via GLUT1 influx + P-gp efflux (BBB) vs source-sink advective mass-flow via cytoplasmic streaming (mycorrhizal Gorzelak 2015); Class K = transporter Michaelis-Menten K_m = 1.5-3.5 mM (BBB Duarte 2009) vs hub-tree power-law connectivity + Michaelis-Menten saturation at root-fungus interface (mycorrhizal Beiler 2010); Class I = circadian 24h permeability rhythm via Mg²⁺-clock + microglia (BBB Cuddapah 2019) vs seasonal C-direction reversal via Douglas-fir ↔ paper birch phenology (mycorrhizal Simard 1997). BBB ADDS Class D + Class E (selectivity dispatch + transporter catalog) on top of the L+M+C+K+I capacitor backbone per [[user_stance_class_substitution_on_invariant_backbone]] — vertebrate-specific transporter selectivity is operator-substitution-on-invariant-backbone generalised beyond sea slugs to tissue-level barriers. Mycorrhizal substrate does NOT explicitly add D+E because its routing logic operates via chemical-signal HDC encoding rather than transporter-catalog lookup. Same cascade-shape backbone; different operator substitutions. Strongest cross-kingdom (vertebrate / multi-kingdom-symbiosis) partition-coexistent attestation in project canon, joined with Spike #130 to demonstrate bipartite-substrate cascade-class universality across animal-tissue and plant-fungus boundaries.
